envelope.note: Implemented both adjudicated P1 boundaries without editing tests or claiming live proof. Assumption for relocation: a stale absolute root is portable only when it retains the exact <id>/snapshot shape and no live foreign target exists; the effective path is rebound to the current canonical store before action. The separate P2 remains: Codex 0.153.3 live containment, resume inheritance, writable-root, snapshot non-write, and TMPDIR behavior were not behaviorally probed. No vendor/model session was started. Commit was attempted but denied by the read-only .git sandbox; out/COMMIT_MSG and the commit object carry the launcher fallback.

commit.subject: dispatch: bind resume settlement and snapshot paths
commit.body:
Settle every read-role resume against the dispatched HEAD and residual-tree invariant, retaining prior refusal evidence and findings. Bind selected records to the current store's canonical id/snapshot path before launcher actions while allowing a relocated store to rebase stale portable paths.

Leave the live Codex containment capability proof explicitly unmeasured.
